title: Unified Origin of the Radial Acceleration Relation and the Hubble Tension via Entropic Gravity Modification
abstract: Identifies a common origin for the Hubble tension and the Radial Acceleration Relation (RAR) via entropy-driven gravity modification. Predicts H_0 ~ 73.9 km/s/Mpc from galaxy rotation data, matching the SH0ES measurement to 1.2%. The MOND acceleration scale a_G is recovered with agreement within 14%.

efc_context.regime_relevance: Unifies galactic-scale RAR with cosmological H0 tension through entropy-driven gravity modification
